about.lede: Vyewfinder Films is an audiovisual production company built on a simple idea: perception determines authority. What people see decides whether they take you seriously.
about.body: We work end to end — direction, cinematography, photography and post — so the story stays intact from the first frame to the final cut. Small team, senior hands, no layers between you and the people doing the work.

timeline.q: How long does a project take?
timeline.a: Most brand films and photo shoots run two to six weeks from kickoff to delivery. Multi-day shoots or campaigns with several deliverables can run longer — we give you a dated schedule before anything is booked.

pricing.a: Projects typically start around $3,500 for a single-day shoot with edit. Final cost depends on crew size, shoot days, locations and how many cuts you need. You get an itemised quote, not a range.

process.q: What does working with you look like?
process.a: A call to understand the goal, then a treatment and quote. Once approved we handle pre-production, the shoot and post. You see a first cut, get two rounds of revisions, and receive final files in every format you need.

travel.a: Yes. We're based in Richmond, VA and shoot regularly across the East Coast and beyond. Travel and lodging are quoted separately and transparently.

rights.a: You do. Final deliverables are yours to use across any channel, in perpetuity. We keep the right to show the work in our own portfolio unless you'd rather we didn't.

podcast.q: Can you produce an ongoing podcast?
podcast.a: Yes — that's a dedicated service. We handle studio setup, multi-cam recording, editing and distribution, either per episode or on a monthly retainer.

welcome.message: Hi! I'm the Vyewfinder Films virtual assistant. We help businesses create professional video, photography, and social content. What are you looking to create?

svc_video.message: Corporate and commercial video is a strong fit when you need to explain your business, promote a service, or tell a brand story. Every project is scoped individually, so the team builds a custom recommendation and quote around your goal, filming needs, deliverables, and timeline.

svc_social.message: We create professional social content, and can discuss support for strategy, production, and editing. The right setup depends on your platforms, how often you want to publish, and whether you need a one-time campaign or an ongoing plan.

menu_photo.message: Which kind of photography are you interested in?

svc_food.message: Food photography is one of our listed services, and the portfolio includes restaurant and hospitality work. To scope it, the team will want to know roughly how many dishes or drinks need coverage, where the images will be used, and your target date.

svc_realestate.message: Real-estate photography is a listed service. To check availability the team will need the property location and type, when it will be photo-ready, your preferred time window, and the listing deadline.

svc_headshots.message: Headshot photography is a listed service, for individuals or whole teams. Scope depends on how many people, the location, the style you want, and where the images will be used.

svc_photo_other.message: That may be something the production team can review. Tell me about the idea, where it would take place, and your timeline, and I'll prepare the request for them.

quote_service.message: I can help prepare a quote request. Which service are you interested in?

quote_goal.message: What would you like the finished content to accomplish?

quote_scope.message: What would you like delivered? For example, roughly how many videos or photos, preferred length, or the platforms they're for.

quote_location.message: Where would filming or photography take place?

quote_date.message: What date or deadline are you working toward?

quote_budget.message: Do you have a working budget or investment range you'd like the team to consider? It's completely fine if you're not sure yet.

consult_intro.message: Happy to help request a consultation. What type of content are you considering, and what business goal should it support?

consult_when.message: What dates and time windows work best for you? Please give at least two options — the team will confirm availability before anything is scheduled.

menu_faq.message: What would you like to know?

faq_pricing.message: Pricing is custom, because scope varies by planning, filming time, locations, crew, editing, versions, and deadline. I don't have a fixed price list to quote from — but I can gather the details so the team can put an accurate number together.

faq_areas.message: Vyewfinder Films is based in Richmond, Virginia. Work outside Richmond isn't publicly defined, so the team confirms availability and any travel considerations for your specific location.

faq_timeline.message: Turnaround depends on the service, deliverables, locations, and production plan, and I don't have confirmed timelines to promise. Share your deadline and the team will confirm whether it's feasible.

faq_spanish.message: Sí — puedes escribirme en español y te respondo en español. Our team messaging includes Spanish, and the team can confirm language availability for a specific meeting.

faq_work.message: Yes — the Services pages include featured video and photography across real estate, beauty, restaurants, financial services, remodeling, and other local-business categories.

consent.message: May I collect your name and preferred contact details so the team can follow up about this project?

lead_name.message: Great — who should the team contact?

lead_business.message: What's your business or organization called?

lead_email.message: What's the best email for them to reach you?

review.message: Here's the request I'll pass along. A team member will review it and confirm scope, availability, and pricing — nothing is booked until they do.

done.message: Thank you. Send it through on WhatsApp for the fastest reply, or email it to the team — either reaches the same people.

declined.message: No problem at all. You can reach the team any time at info@vyewfinderfilms.com or 804-998-0564 whenever you're ready.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, exactly which ones Vyewfinder Films (“we,” “us,” or “our”) uses on vyewfinderfilms.com (the “Site”), and how you can control them. If anything here is unclear, contact us using the details in Section 8.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies?
body: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores on your device (computer, phone, or tablet) when you visit it. Cookies let a site remember things about your visit — like a preference you set, or whether you’ve already answered a prompt — so it doesn’t have to ask again every time you load a page.

Cookies cannot access other files on your device, run programs, or carry viruses. Some of what this policy describes is technically stored using “similar technologies” such as your browser’s local storage rather than a literal cookie — we use the word “cookie” throughout to cover both, since they work the same way from your side.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies We Use
body: We keep this list short on purpose — it reflects exactly what this Site sets, not a generic list of what a website might do. We update it whenever that changes.

rows: Remembers whether you’ve chosen light or dark mode
Remembers the cookie choices you make in the banner, so we don’t ask again every visit

bodyAfter: We do not use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Google Ads, Hotjar, or any comparable analytics or advertising tool. If that ever changes, we will update this policy first and ask for your consent through the cookie banner before any such cookie is set.

sections.heading: 3. Embedded Content (YouTube)
body: Our Podcast page can display an embedded YouTube video. Unlike the cookies listed in Section 2, we do not control what YouTube itself does once its player loads — Google may set its own cookies for purposes including analytics, personalisation, and advertising, governed by Google’s own privacy policy, not ours.

Because of that, this embed does not load automatically. It only loads once you actively enable the “Functional” category — either from the cookie banner, from Cookie Settings, or by clicking “Allow & Play” directly on the video. Until you do, you’ll see a static thumbnail with a link that opens the video on YouTube’s own site in a new tab instead — visiting that link does not itself set any cookie from this Site.
You can review Google’s own cookie and privacy practices at policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: 4. How to Control Cookies
body: On this Site: use the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer at any time to change your choice — you don’t need to wait for the banner to reappear.

In your browser: most browsers let you block or delete cookies for any site through their settings menu. Doing so may reset preferences on this Site (for example, your theme choice) each time you visit, since the cookie that remembers it would be gone too.

sections.heading: 5. Categories, Explained
body: The categories below are the same ones offered in the cookie banner and Cookie Settings, restated here so this policy stands on its own.

definitionList.def: Required for the Site to work at all. Cannot be turned off. On this Site: the theme-preference cookie and the cookie-consent cookie itself.
Enables optional embedded content from other sites. On this Site: the YouTube video embed on the Podcast page, described in Section 3.
Would measure how the Site is used. Not currently active on this Site — see Section 2.
Would support advertising or ad measurement. Not currently active on this Site — see Section 2.

sections.heading: 6. Information You Choose to Share With Us
body: Cookies are different from information you actively type and submit — for example, your name, email, phone number, or project details through our contact form or website chatbot. That information is not stored as a cookie or similar technology; it’s sent directly to our team so we can respond to your enquiry.
This document covers cookies specifically. If you have questions about how information submitted through our forms or chatbot is handled, contact us using the details in Section 8.

sections.heading: 7. Your Choices and Rights
body: Wherever you’re visiting from, the cookie banner and Cookie Settings on this Site let you accept or reject every non-essential cookie category described above, and you can change that choice at any time.

Depending on where you live, you may also have additional rights under laws such as the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation, or U.S. state privacy laws including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA) and the Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA). Many of the specific rights those laws create — such as opting out of the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information, or of targeted advertising — concern practices this Site does not engage in: we do not sell personal information, and we do not use cookies for targeted advertising.
If you believe that has changed, or you’d like to exercise a right that applies to you, contact us using the details in Section 8 and we will respond.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use, or for legal or regulatory reasons. We’ll update the “Last updated” date above when we do, and if a change affects an optional cookie category, we will ask for your consent again rather than assuming an earlier choice still applies.
